name: Meta One offer page, scrolled
identifier_found: this is the Meta One offer page scrolled: its title is above the viewport and does not collapse into a bar; visible text is benefit rows, plan section names and the "Start your free week" footer
initial_rationale: this is the Meta One offer page scrolled: its title is above the viewport and does not collapse into a bar; visible text is benefit rows, plan section names and the "Start your free week" footer

test_cases.precondition: Meta One offer page ("Try Meta One Core free for one ..." at top), reached via Subscriptions > Meta One > View all benefits
test_cases.action: scroll the benefit list down the captured distance, then twice as far, then partway back up
test_cases.expected_result: title stays, collapses to a bar, returns on partial scroll-back, or is gone
test_cases.confirms_if: the title scrolls off with the content and does not return until the very top
test_cases.overturns_if: a pinned or collapsed title appears, or the title returns on a small scroll back
test_cases.observed_result: the large title scrolled off with the list; the top shows only a Close (X) and "View all plans" over a gradient; scrolling back ~500 px still showed no title — it reappears only at the top of the page. Live title now reads "free for one month" (capture: one week)

deciding_evidence: confirmed on the device: the title scrolls away and does not return until the top; this screen is reached by touches ("Show more", "Close") so it is judged as a screen; no evaluated transition lands here; no confirmed Disappearing View Identifier transition lands here
recommendation: pin the offer title, or collapse it into a persistent bar ("Meta One Core") when it scrolls away
